newsitem.title: USA: WHX unit ups offer for Dynamics. [CORRECTED 21:20 GMT]
newsitem.headline: WHX unit ups offer for Dynamics. [CORRECTED 21:20 GMT]

text.p: WHX Corp said on Tuesday its SB Acquisition Corp subsidiary extended its tender offer for Dynamics Corp of America until June 13, and increased the cash offer to $56 per share from $45 (corrects amount).
Dynamics on May 12 agreed to be acquired by CTS Corp for $55 per share in cash and stock.
WHX said in a news release that the only impediment to its latest proposal was Dynamics's shareholder rights plan, which WHX urged Dynamics to rescind.
WHX said its offer was a better deal for Dynamics shareholders than the CTS offer to acquire 50 percent of the company immediately for cash, and the balance several months later for stock.
Dynamics makes consumer electrical housewares and industrial equipment. Its shares were up 1/2 to 57-1/4 in afternoon trading.
WHX, a steelmaker, was trading down 1/8 to 6-1/4, while CTS, which makes custom electronic components, was up 1-1/4 to 67-1/2.
